import sys

def bin_pow(a, b, p):
    if b == 0:
        return 1
    x = bin_pow(a, b // 2, p)
    x = (x * x) % p
    if b & 1:
        x = (x * a) % p
    return x

def solve(n, bit, k, l):
    global g, rfact, p, cnt
    if k == len(bit):
        cnt += 1
        for i in range(1, 17):
            g[n][i] += rfact[l] * g[n ^ l][i - 1]
            if cnt >= 8:
                g[n][i] %= p
        if cnt >= 8:
            cnt = 0
        return
    solve(n, bit, k + 1, l)
    solve(n, bit, k + 1, l ^ (1 << bit[k]))

def main():
    global g, rfact, p, cnt
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    p = int(data[2])

    if n & 1:
        print(bin_pow(k, n, p))
        return

    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    rfact = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p
        rfact[i] = bin_pow(fact[i], p - 2, p)

    g = [[0] * 17 for _ in range(n + 1)]
    g[0][0] = 1
    cnt = 0

    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if (i & n) != i:
            continue
        bit = []
        for j in range(18):
            if (1 << j) & i:
                bit.append(j)
        solve(i, bit, 1, 1 << bit[0])
        for j in range(17):
            g[i][j] %= p

    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, min(16, k) + 1):
        cur = fact[n] * g[n][i] % p
        cur = cur * fact[k] % p
        cur = cur * rfact[k - i] % p
        ans = (ans + cur) % p

    ans = bin_pow(k, n, p) - ans
    if ans < 0:
        ans += p
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
